svg.title: HydroCap — offset-neck wave bottle
svg.desc: Original asymmetric blue bottle with a right-offset neck, rising slanted cap, broad tapered body and an enclosed negative-space water wave. Transparent canvas.
svg.metadata: Original HydroCap artwork. Independently constructed cubic Bezier geometry; no imported, traced or font-derived artwork. Licensed under the repository's PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0 license; see ../../LICENSE and PROVENANCE.md.
